item.description: Singapore's Ministry of Manpower (MOM) is investigating about 45 companies involved in Changi Airport operations over suspected work pass offenses after an inspection found holders of passes meant for foreign professionals handling baggage.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Stolen $291,000 watch comes back to Tokyo shop by courier with handwritten apology
item.description: An Audemars Piguet watch worth about 46 million yen (US$291,300) that a man tried on and ran off with at a Tokyo shop has been returned by courier with a handwritten apology.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Vietnam, Japan's biggest source of foreign workers, struggles to recruit more
item.description: Vietnamese recruitment firms that once had seven or eight applicants for every Japan job order now send staff into villages and still find it hard to fill their quotas.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Which Asian city ranks world's best for Gen Z in 2026?
item.description: Thousands of young people worldwide have shared what makes a city appealing, revealing the best places for them to live.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Bangkok firm behind 'Taobao Thailand' website accused of illegal yuan exchange for buyers of Chinese goods
item.description: Thai police have arrested the director of a Bangkok company behind a website called Taobao Thailand over an unlicensed yuan exchange and payment service for people buying goods from China.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Over 5,200 vapes and components found in 4 foreigners' luggage at Singapore Changi airport
item.description: Officers at Singapore Changi Airport found 5,272 vaporizers and related components in the luggage of four arriving foreign travelers last week, the largest haul from four days of stepped-up checks at the country's checkpoints.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Hanoi to offer $154 to women having 2 children before age 35
item.description: Hanoi will provide a one-off payment of VND4 million (US$154) to women who give birth to two children before the age of 35 from next year, under a policy aimed to boost the city's birth rate.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Malaysia Airlines becomes latest carrier hit by Amadeus booking system data breach
item.description: Malaysia Airlines said Sunday that some customer information may have been compromised in a cybersecurity incident involving Amadeus, a global travel technology provider based in Spain whose systems support airline reservations and passenger services.

item.title: VnExpress (Vietnam): Jet nosedives, erupts into fireball near South Florida busy roadway, killing all 9 on board
item.description: A business jet carrying nine people nose-dived into a South Florida neighborhood Sunday and erupted into a giant fireball that appeared to just miss homes near a busy roadway. Everyone on board was killed, the nation's transportation secretary said.
